sanskrit_verse: पञ्चधा संभृतः कायो यदि पञ्चत्वम् आगतः । कर्मभिः स्वशरीरोत्थैस् तत्र का परिदेवना ॥
transliteration: pañcadhā saṃbhṛtaḥ kāyo yadi pañcatvam āgataḥ | karmabhiḥ svaśarīrotthais tatra kā paridevanā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the body constituted of five elements dissolves back into those five, due to actions born of its own bodily origin, what lamentation remains?
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the causal continuum of embodied action
Causation is neither moral nor punitive but sequential in nature
Capacity-based responsibility arises only where embodiment allows choice
Restoration logic operates through recognition of elemental return
Consciousness alignment requires dissolution of false ownership over action
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity dissolves into its constituent causal origins THEN no external liability accrues beyond completion of karmic sequence
IF action originates from embodied capacity THEN consequence aligns with natural dissolution process
IF no continuity of conscious agency exists post-dissolution THEN legal identity ceases without residue
IF suffering arises during transition THEN it shall be addressed via consciousness restoration, not punitive attribution
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning death, dissolution, or cessation of legal personhood, the threshold for judicial intervention lies solely in verifying alignment with natural dharma-flow. No punitive judgment attaches to dissolution that follows lawful karmic progression.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms that all bodies arise and dissolve by elemental causality; hence, there is no basis for assigning fault beyond individual capacity. Anupūrvaśaḥ establishes that consequences follow inherent sequences, not imposed penalties. Thus, responsibility is proportional only to the degree of conscious volition retained at time of dissolution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Facilitate full return to elemental state without obstruction
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Confirm conscious acceptance of prior actions before transition
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Realign residual energies toward harmonious integration
Integrity Reintegration Pathway: Ensure no fragmentation remains unaddressed in causal field
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism as Source-Authority: This law proceeds directly from the ontological truth of embodiment and dissolution. Dharma stands restored through recognition of natural sequence. Reality holds no place for punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
